extras: Warning: Rewrites all pen events globally; disable if using a graphics tablet or stylus.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that fixes Canvas drag-and-drop on Linux when an ordinary mouse is misclassified as a pen device
problem: Standard mouse input is misclassified as a pen device by Chromium on certain Linux setups, preventing Canvas drag-and-drop functionality.
summary: A fix for Canvas drag-and-drop issues on Linux caused by Chromium misclassifying standard mouse input as a pen device.
